Author: anfroholic
Content:
I mean, there are other words you can use, but it's unnecessary. 
If you're designing for something else to fit in/on/around you can apply GD&T stuff that basically outlines some tolerances on the part they may not have. 
Other stuff like form/fit/function, but again, a lot of this is just embedded into a mechanical drawing if you desire.
